The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues, so there is nothing for POL-GEN-05 to execute and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded.

The judge's explanation, as written

To both parties: this case goes to a human reviewer and the SGD 4.50 no-show fee is held rather than collected or refunded while that review is pending. Neither of you moves money today. On the trip itself, the driver's account is supported. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02727) shows the driver en route from 22:33, tapping 'I'm Here' at 22:40:11 and cancelling at 22:48:15 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02727) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 22:40:11 for one continuous 484-second run of 49 qualifying fixes. That satisfies POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d): arrival event present, geofence entry at that event, a 484-second dwell against the 180-second free waiting period, and termination under a recognised no-show code after the dwell elapsed. The arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05 (he was stationary at the pin, not driving past), POL-NS-06's shortfall rule has nothing to bite on, and POL-NS-03 does not apply because his fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it. The fare line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with the SGD 4.50 platform fee under POL-NS-08(d). The rider's exoneration route could not be run: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02727) holds a single driver message and none from the rider, and the rider's device sat roughly 700 m from the pin throughout, so POL-NS-04 fails at limbs (a) and (c). The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02727-01, weight 0.0) is not needed, because the dwell already exceeded the minimum. That would ordinarily mean the fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee (the money block's own driver_compensation figure). I cannot process it. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check trips on the driver's own trailing-30-day numbers: no_show_terminations_30d is 4 (the test needs 4 or more) and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Those are the only two profile fields the clause reads; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter of 7 is context only under POL-GEN-01 and played no part. Compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Escalation is terminal and replaces any monetary outcome. The driver's request that the charge simply stand (POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION) is displaced: NO_ACTION would leave the rider charged, whereas escalation holds the fee. The rider's request for a refund is not granted now either. POL-NS-07 directs the escalation packet to instruct the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.50 cancellation fee in full, and that instruction is recorded as a referral; the SGD 4.50 stays frozen meanwhile. The reviewer must settle one open question: whether the driver's four no-show terminations in the last 30 days at a 0.10 rate reflect fee-farming, in which case the rider's fee is refunded in full, or whether this trip was a genuine no-show that the pattern alone should not distort. My confidence is 0.9; every artifact this finding rests on carries a weight multiplier of 1.0, so nothing is discounted and the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 trips on the driver's own trailing-window record: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4, which is '4 or more', and 4 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, which is greater than the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs are therefore satisfied on the driver's own numbers, compensation must be WITHHELD, and the case must escalate under POL-NS-09(d); the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags (7) is a different field and may not be substituted for the trailing-30-day figure.

evidence EV-DPROF-02727 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-01

kept Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal and replaces any monetary outcome: the Judge issues no monetary ruling and the disputed amount is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded. On the fare ledger's present state - cancellation_fee 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 - that is the only disposition under which the rider is not left carrying the $4.50 while the platform reviews a driver with four no-show terminations in the last 30 days.

evidence EV-DPROF-02727, EV-FARE-02727 · clauses POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-03

kept POL-NS-07 does more than withhold the driver's payout on these facts: it requires the escalation packet to DIRECT THE REVIEWER to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full. The file that goes to human review therefore carries a rider refund instruction on the $4.50, while the amount itself is held rather than collected or refunded by the automated pipeline in the interim.

evidence EV-FARE-02727, EV-DPROF-02727 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-09

kept The escalation on this file is driven entirely by the driver's pattern and not by any rider-abuse signal: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so the second limb of POL-NS-09(d) and the two-party limb of POL-NS-09(c) do not fire, and no limb of POL-NS-09 points back at this rider's own conduct.

evidence EV-RPROF-02727 · clauses POL-NS-09

The driver advocate

kept Limb (a) of the baseline no-show test is met: the trip record for TRP-02727 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-07T22:40:11+08:00, sourced from platform telemetry, after the driver had been navigating to the registered pickup point since 22:33:03.

evidence EV-TRIP-02727 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept Limb (b) is met on the trace itself and needs no assertion of proximity. The derived arrival block reports a long qualifying in-geofence run beginning at 2026-09-07T22:40:11+08:00 - the exact second of the 'arrived' event - containing 49 qualifying fixes within the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the minimum distance from the pin anywhere in the derived driver track is 0.0 m. The arrival geofence test of POL-NS-02 is therefore satisfied, not failed, and the driver is deemed to have arrived.

evidence EV-GPS-02727, EV-TRIP-02727 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

kept Limb (c) is met with a wide margin: the effective in-geofence dwell is a single continuous run of 484 seconds, against a free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip, and the derived shortfall is -304 seconds. There is no shortfall, so POL-NS-06 has nothing to bite on and the waiting period the rider paid for was served in full.

evidence EV-GPS-02727, EV-TRIP-02727 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-06

kept Limb (d) is met: the record shows no boarding event, the trip was terminated by the driver at 2026-09-07T22:48:15+08:00 - 484 seconds after the dwell began - and the cancellation is recorded under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold, so the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable.

evidence EV-TRIP-02727 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The arrival marker is not a false-arrival marker under POL-NS-05. The first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the 'arrived' timestamp, so no admissible fix places the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the moment of the marker, and a single continuous in-geofence run of 49 fixes is inconsistent with an arrival tapped while driving through. Even if the marker were held false, limb (iii) preserves the fee: the clock recomputed from that same first qualifying in-geofence fix still yields a 484 second dwell, above the 180 second minimum, and any false-arrival record is a referral that never suppresses the money.

evidence EV-GPS-02727, EV-TRIP-02727 · clauses POL-NS-05

kept POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. Limb (a) fails: the chat log holds exactly one message, sent by the driver at 22:40:31 ('im at the pickup point'), and nothing from the rider at all. Limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than undecidable: the rider track is present with 83 fixes, not one of them within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0), the rider's device sitting roughly 697 m to 705 m from the pin throughout. POL-NS-11 therefore has no work to do here, and the clause cannot be run in the rider's favour.

evidence EV-CHAT-02727, EV-GPS-02727 · clauses POL-NS-04, POL-NS-11

kept POL-NS-03 is not engaged. That clause decides a driver stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here the driver's fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, the minimum distance to the pin across the derived driver track being 0.0 m. This is not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case, and no goodwill payment or rider refund follows from it.

evidence EV-GPS-02727, EV-TRIP-02727 · clauses POL-NS-03

kept There is no fare defect to excuse the charge. The fare breakdown's cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 equals the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50 recorded on this trip, so the POL-NS-08(d) reconciliation is satisfied for the net figure, and the ledger shows SGD 4.50 charged with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00. The amount the rider contests is the amount the schedule fixes.

evidence EV-FARE-02727, EV-TRIP-02727 · clauses POL-NS-08

kept With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee - SGD 3.60, which is the money block's own computed driver_compensation figure. I rely only on the two trailing-30-day fields the clause names, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not the field this test reads. I disclose the one qualification on this record: both limbs of the anti-farming check are met (no_show_terminations_30d is 4, and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, above 0.08), so compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). That is a routing consequence of the checker, not a finding that this trip was a farmed no-show, and escalation holds the fee rather than refunding it: this trip's own evidence - a 484 second continuous dwell inside a 50 m radius, a single unanswered driver message, and a rider device stationary some 700 m from the pin - describes a genuine no-show.

evidence EV-DPROF-02727, EV-FARE-02727, EV-GPS-02727 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-01

kept Whatever the routing of the compensation question, the rider's claim to have the SGD 4.50 returned is not supported on this evidence: no rider-exonerating clause of the no-show policy applies, so no refund is licensed. Under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION is party-relative - on this rider-filed dispute it leaves the present payment state exactly as it stands, with the charge in place and refund_issued_sgd at 0.00, and it never restores a charge.

evidence EV-FARE-02727, EV-TRIP-02727 · clauses POL-GEN-03, POL-NS-01
